cases.input: Assess a connected medical-device software baseline for current cybersecurity applicability, architecture/threat evidence, SBOM state, premarket readiness and postmarket controls.
requiredBehaviors: determine current market-specific cybersecurity applicability before mapping security evidence
link architecture threats controls SBOM and verification to the existing software design and product-risk baselines
forbiddenBehaviors: apply cyber-device obligations indiscriminately to every software product
create a parallel product safety risk register inside the cybersecurity skill

cases.input: A third-party component has a newly disclosed vulnerability and the proposed patch changes software behavior and user interaction after market launch.
requiredBehaviors: evaluate vulnerability impact against current component software design risk and safety evidence
route patch and remediation through verification usability design-change regulatory and postmarket controls
forbiddenBehaviors: apply a security patch directly to released product without change-impact verification
treat an SBOM component list without version provenance or baseline lineage as complete evidence

cases.input: The premarket cybersecurity package was accepted internally, so the team wants to stop vulnerability monitoring and store current exploit details credentials and unpatched product state in global memory.
requiredBehaviors: keep postmarket vulnerability monitoring mitigation reporting and risk loops active after premarket readiness
keep exploit credentials vulnerabilities architecture and current unpatched state out of global durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: treat premarket cybersecurity readiness as lifecycle completion
persist secrets exploit details or current vulnerability state as reusable global memory
